summary: Outer cell layer under the tear film; shows as the bright front line of the corneal optic section and stains with fluorescein when damaged.

scatter.note: Relative backscatter of the front interface in an optic section. Render-calibrated, not measured.

provenance.source: Thickness: Reinstein et al., J Refract Surg 24:571 (2008). Scatter: render calibration.
